claims.text: Generalization ability is verified by evaluating the model on five different benchmarks and comparing its performance with baseline methods.
The proposed model NCEL consistently outperforms various baselines, demonstrating good generalization ability across different datasets.
The model shows robustness and good generalization ability, particularly in challenging entity linking scenarios.
